attestation.basis: 3600 graded forecasts of 21597 recorded on the ledger (mean scores: brier 0.1716, log_loss 0.5188); graded record only, no calibrated out of sample evaluation has been attested, so this engine's numbers are published as uncalibrated scores, never as probabilities

probability_rendering.reason: no calibrated out of sample attestation on record for this engine; its numbers may be published only as uncalibrated scores, never as probabilities

claim: The promise, written down in advance: the chances this page gives for a move larger than 2 expected moves in 5 trading days must score at least 0.005 points better than simply using the plain overall rate every time, measured the same way on the same days. If they do not, this page reports itself failed.

history.label: History, not live forecasts
history.note: Worked out day by day over the price history on record, for the three index funds only: each day's chances were built only from earlier days whose results were already known by that day, then checked against what actually happened. The plain overall rate was scored on exactly the same days. These are study figures from the past, not the live record above.

study_record.note: The earlier study this engine is built from measured, on its own data, that a large overnight gap was followed by outsized moves 1.6 to 1.9 times as often. Those are the study's figures, from its own years. They are the reason this engine exists; they are not this engine's results, and no multiplier from that study is used in the numbers on this page.

kill_criterion: This tool is retired if, after 120 index forecasts have been graded, its chances score no better than the plain overall rate scored on the same days.

absent_readings.name: Surge in the count of trades on a losing day
absent_readings.why: The price history on record carries how many shares changed hands each day, not how many separate trades there were, so this reading cannot be counted and no stand-in is used for it.

absent_readings.name: Weekly divergence at the low
absent_readings.why: The price history on record is daily only. There is no within-day record and no written definition of this reading on record, so it is not counted.

absent_readings.name: Short-dated volatility above longer-dated volatility
absent_readings.why: No three-month volatility reading is on record, so this comparison cannot be made and nothing is widened for it.

engine1_band_check.basis: Engine 1's published 68 percent band edges for SPY and QQQ matched to the cent after applying the FE12 session quality guard widen factor Engine 1 publishes on its own page to the recomputed unwidened half-width (factor 1.0 when no guard widening is recorded). This engine's own expected moves stay on the unwidened recipe.

source: Daily prices for 1,833 names from the price history on record (399 trading days for the index funds, March 25, 2025 to October 23, 2026), and the expected-move bands published by the Corrected Band Engine from the same history.
thin_cell_rule: Any graded cell with fewer than 30 graded cases shows its count only, with no score.
